# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-4400 # Review — PAN-4400 ## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — the OpenAI preset is never blocked for missing credentials or a missing codex harness, contrary to the issue Design, PRD D8 and the PR's own docs ## Context - Run ID: agent-pan-4400-review-ec3dc03b - Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4400/.pan/review/agent-pan-4400-review-ec3dc03b/context.json - Branch / workspace: feature/pan-4400 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4400 - PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/4412 (no prior reviews) - HEAD reviewed: ec3dc03b96423789da302ab63c5bc9e783b30aed - Base / prior cycle SHA: merge-base with origin/main e81b508146c; no prior review cycle ## Blocking Findings ### [requirements] OpenAI preset has no working credential or harness gate — `src/lib/model-presets/plan.ts:252` - Severity: `!` MUST - Classification / requirement scope: specification defect in the PRD's "verified fact" 6, which the implementation follows faithfully; in_pr_scope. It also creates a validation gap (the test only stubs the trigger). - Requirement text: - Issue #4400 Design: "requires that provider's credentials/harness to be available, and says what it could not set." - PRD D8: "Credentials gate the whole preset. If `getProviderAuthMode()` returns `undefined`, the plan is `blocked` … and apply refuses." - PRD fact 6 (the flawed premise): "`getProviderAuthMode(model)` … returns `'api-key' | 'subscription' | undefined`; `undefined` means no credentials." - The PR's own user docs, `configuration/model-presets.mdx` lines 78-80: "If the preset's provider has no credentials (no `claude` or `codex login` sign-in and no API key), the whole preset is blocked and nothing is written." - Trigger and changed-code connection: `planPresetApplyFromText` gates the whole plan on `authMode === undefined` (plan.ts lines 252-256). For OpenAI, `getProviderAuthMode` (`src/lib/agents/runtime-command.ts` lines 661-667) returns `authStatus.loggedIn ? 'subscription' : (config.providerAuth?.openai ?? 'api-key')`. It returns a *mode*, not a presence check, so it never returns `undefined` for OpenAI. The harness gate then calls `canUseHarness('codex', gpt-6-*, 'api-key', {})`, which is ALLOWED (`codexModelFloorDecision` only checks the version floor under subscription auth). Nothing checks that the `codex` binary exists. - Expected / observed / impact: - Expected: with no `codex login`, no OpenAI API key and no codex binary, "Apply OpenAI defaults" shows a blocked plan with a sign-in reason, and apply refuses. - Observed: the plan is not blocked and offers 33 `change` rows. Confirming rewrites all three workhorse slots to GPT-6, every role's model and effort, tier harnesses to `codex`, and `models.providers.openai` to `{enabled: true, harness: codex}`. - Impact: this is one of the two headline buttons. An operator without OpenAI credentials gets one-click config under which every agent launch goes to a codex harness that cannot authenticate (or is not installed). Undo exists, but the safety check the issue asked for and the docs promise does not exist. - The Anthropic gate works: the same probe returns `blocked: "Anthropic has no credentials…"` and 0 change rows. - The five numbered issue ACs (1-5) are otherwise met. This finding is against the issue Design requirement, PRD D8 and the PR's documentation, not against AC 1-5. - Evidence: - Runtime probe (scratchpad only, isolated `HOME` and `OVERDECK_HOME`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`/`CODEX_API_KEY`/`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` unset, `codex` not on `PATH`), calling the real `getProviderAuthMode` and `planPresetApply`. Output: - `authMode openai = api-key` - `authMode anthropic = undefined` - `openai blocked = undefined changes = 33` - `anthropic blocked = {"reason":"Anthropic has no credentials. …"} changes = 0` - Validation gap: `tests/unit/lib/model-presets/plan.test.ts` "blocks when the provider has no credentials" stubs `getAuthMode → undefined`. It proves the gate fires when told to. It does not prove that anything ever tells it to for OpenAI. - Limit: I did not click the button in a live dashboard. The route and UI call the same `planPresetApply`, and the route test shows the plan passes through unchanged. - Fix: - Spec correction: fact 6 and D8 should say that OpenAI credential presence is not derivable from `getProviderAuthMode`. - Code fix: make the credential dep a presence check per provider. - OpenAI: use the existing source of truth behind `GET /api/settings/openai-auth`, i.e. `getOpenAIAuthStatus()` (`src/lib/openai-auth.ts` line 122): `loggedIn || hasOpenAIApiKey`, or a resolved OpenAI API key from env/config (`apiKeys.openai`). Match how Settings → Providers decides OpenAI is configured, rather than adding a fourth notion of "has credentials". - Anthropic: keep the current check. - Codex-harness preset: also block when `resolveHarnessBinary('codex')` is null, with an install hint. The issue says "credentials/harness to be available". - Tests: add a plan test that drives the real OpenAI trigger (not-logged-in and no key → `blocked`, zero `change` rows), for example by stubbing `getOpenAIAuthStatus` or by injecting a `hasCredentials` dep whose default is the real presence check. - Keep `configuration/model-presets.mdx` lines 78-80 true after the fix. ## Non-blocking Findings ### `~` [correctness] Untouched flow collections are reformatted — `src/lib/model-presets/apply.ts:110` The unscoped `doc.toString({ lineWidth: 0 })` rewrites flow sequences on nodes the plan never touched: `difficulties: [trivial]` becomes `difficulties: [ trivial ]` (yaml's default `flowCollectionPadding: true`). - This breaks the letter of NFR-1 ("byte-identical") and the NFR-2 clause "every node the apply did not touch keeps its exact original text". - Semantics hold. An isolated probe applied and undid both the `anthropic` and `openai` presets on a tiered config with a distribution and a supervisor, and `isDeepStrictEqual` of the parsed documents was `true`. - The existing writers (`src/lib/settings-api.ts` line 859, `config-yaml/load.ts` line 502) behave the same way, and Overdeck-written files already use padded style. The yaml library cannot preserve mixed padded and unpadded styles in one file, so this is a documented limitation, not a bug to chase. - Optional: pass `flowCollectionPadding` to match the file's dominant style, or soften NFR-1's wording. ### `?` [security] The provider-node row carries `api_key` into plan output When `models.providers.

` is an object with a literal `api_key`, `providerRow` puts the whole node, including the key, into the row's `before` and `after`. - The key then shows in `GET /api/model-presets/:id/plan`, in the Settings diff dialog, and in new CLI stdout (`show`, `apply --dry-run`, `--json`). - `GET /api/settings` already returns keys unmasked to the authenticated local dashboard (PRD fact 1), so this is parity under the local threat model. The CLI stdout and on-screen dialog surfaces are new, though (screen sharing, terminal logs). - Hazard for whoever fixes this: do not redact inside the row. `applyPreset` writes `row.after` verbatim, and `providerRow` builds `after = { ...before, enabled, harness }`, so a redaction marker in the row would be written into config.yaml as the key. - Redact only at the presentation layer (format.ts, the route response, the dialog), or have apply re-read the node and merge only `enabled`/`harness`. If the response is redacted, the digest must still be computed over the unredacted rows, or the route and CLI must share one redaction rule. ### `≉` [ux] A stale-plan 409 leaves the dialog on the stale plan — `ModelPresetsBar.tsx:120` After a 409 `stale-plan`, the dialog shows the error but keeps the old plan, and Confirm stays enabled. Every retry gets 409 again until the user closes and reopens the dialog. Refetching the plan on 409 (or disabling Confirm with a "Refresh preview" action) would complete the recovery path. The error text does tell the user to review again. ### `?` [correctness] A debounced autosave pending during an apply can revert preset paths `handlePresetChanged` refreshes `formData`, but an autosave that was already debounced captured the stale `next` snapshot. That save can PUT stale values after the preset lands. It needs a text edit within the debounce window just before confirming. Calling `flushAutosave()` before opening the dialog would close it. This is the same class of risk as PRD hazard H1, which is out of scope. ### Resolved / not an issue - Stub-UI flag `ModelPresetsBar.tsx:67` (`useState(false)` for `busy`) is a false positive. `setBusy(true)` runs at line 112 and `setBusy(false)` at line 134, around the apply POST. - Non-goals: `src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts`, `src/lib/providers.ts`, `src/lib/config-yaml/roles.ts`, `src/lib/config-yaml/defaults.ts` and `scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt` are not in the 37-file changeset, so NG-2/3/4/10 hold by the file list. - No Gemini preset exists (NG-1). - Nothing auto-applies; `updateAvailable` only renders a notice (NG-5). - Undo is single-level; a new apply replaces the record (NG-6). - Preset writes do not use `saveSettingsApi`/`writeYamlConfigPreservingComments` (NG-7/12). - Tiers and the supervisor are only edited when present, and `enabled` is never touched (NG-8). - State lives in `~/.overdeck/model-presets-state.json`, not config.yaml (NG-9). ## Coverage ### Changed-file ledger | File | Status | |---|---| | src/lib/model-presets/presets.ts | Reviewed. Registry covers 3 workhorses, 10 roles × model/effort, 4 lanes × model/effort, and background keys; values match the PRD table. | | src/lib/model-presets/plan.ts | Reviewed. Credential gate defect (blocking). Harness gate, tier bands, provider node and digest are correct. | | src/lib/model-presets/apply.ts | Reviewed. CAS, validation, containers and undo are correct. Flow-padding advisory. | | src/lib/model-presets/state.ts | Reviewed. Atomic temp + rename, mode preserved, async fs only. | | src/lib/model-presets/format.ts | Reviewed. | | src/dashboard/server/routes/model-presets.ts | Reviewed. Both POSTs guarded by `rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest`; error mapping 404/409/400; TTS refresh after write. | | src/dashboard/server/server.ts | Reviewed. Layer mounted after `settingsRouteLayer`. | | src/cli/commands/models.ts, src/cli/command-groups.ts, src/cli/index.ts | Reviewed. | | src/dashboard/frontend/.../ModelPresetsBar.tsx, PresetDiffDialog.tsx | Reviewed. CSRF headers via `dashboardMutationJsonHeaders` (sets Content-Type JSON + token); style tokens only; the stale-409 advisory. | | src/dashboard/frontend/.../SettingsPage.tsx | Reviewed. `setFormData(fresh)` does not schedule an autosave (only `applySettings` does); Workhorse/Roles panels read `['settings']` and refresh on invalidation. | | packages/contracts/src/composer-commands.generated.ts | Reviewed (generated manifest rows for `pan models preset *`). | | package.json | Reviewed. `ModelPresetsBar.test.tsx` added to `test:frontend-subset`. | | tests/unit/lib/model-presets/{presets,plan,apply}.test.ts, tests/unit/dashboard/server/routes/model-presets.test.ts, tests/unit/cli/models-preset.test.ts, frontend ModelPresetsBar.test.tsx, SettingsPage.test.ts | Reviewed. Credential test only stubs the trigger (validation gap in the blocker). | | tests/unit/lib/overdeck/no-loss-matrix.ts | Reviewed. Four rows for the new routes. | | tests/fixtures/synced-skills.txt, sync-sources/skills/pan-models/SKILL.md, sync-sources/skills/pan/SKILL.md | Reviewed. The skill repeats the credential-block promise. | | configuration/model-presets.mdx, configuration/harnesses.mdx, docs.json, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/MODEL-CALLS.md, docs/MODEL_ROUTING.md, docs/model-evals/README.md | Reviewed. E2 numbers are beside the review placement and "Research-backed" is beside each OpenAI placement. No `xhigh`/`max` default. Lines 78-80 promise the gate that does not hold for OpenAI. | | .pan/drafts/PAN-4400.md, .pan/continues/PAN-4400.xbrief.json, .pan/specs xbrief, .overdeck/context/codebase/concerns.md | N/A: planning artifacts, used as requirements input only. | ### Dimensions - **Correctness.** Traced plan → apply → CAS → state and undo, including containers, the removed-distribution round trip, boolean provider nodes, `parent` resolution, and effort validation through `effortConfigErrors`/`validateTieredExecutionConfig`. The runtime probe confirmed tiered apply and undo for both presets. - **Security.** POST CSRF/origin/content-type guard is present, and the UI sends the headers. The config write is path-scoped, and there is no plaintext env-key write-back (fixture test covers `$OPENAI_API_KEY` and an env secret). `api_key` display is advisory. - **Performance.** Planning is O(rows) with a cached harness-context map. It uses async fs only. `getProviderAuthMode`'s sync `loadYamlConfig` is pre-existing, cached, and shared with existing routes. No user-sized loops. - **Requirements/UX.** See the matrix below. The credential/harness gate is blocking. ### AC matrix | AC | Status | Evidence | |---|---|---| | Issue AC1 / AC-WI-3 (other keys untouched, `$VAR` and masked keys) | Met (semantic); byte-level advisory | apply.test.ts fixture test; CI green | | Issue AC2 / AC-WI-3 (undo restores exactly) | Met | apply.test.ts boolean node round trip; my tiered probe gives deep-equal `true` | | Issue AC3 / AC-WI-5 (CLI dry-run = UI diff) | Met | models-preset.test.ts dry-run JSON; route and CLI share `planPresetApply` | | Issue AC4 / AC-WI-1 (unknown id fails tests) | Met | presets.test.ts `unknownPresetModelIds` | | Issue AC5 / AC-WI-9 (docs evidence) | Met | model-presets.mdx lines 105, 122, 154-169; six docs link it | | AC-WI-2 (plan tests) | Met as written; validation gap | The blocked case only stubs `getAuthMode` | | AC-WI-4 (routes, 403, 409, no-loss matrix) | Met | route tests; CI green | | AC-WI-6/7/8 (isolated Playwright) | Unverified | The work agent reported these not run; left to UAT. Unit tests cover the mechanisms. | | Issue Design / PRD D8 (credentials/harness gate) | **Unmet for OpenAI** | Runtime probe above | | FR-10 update notice, FR-11 formData refresh | Met | ModelPresetsBar tests; SettingsPage source test; traced that `setFormData` does not autosave | | NFR-3 (no hardcoded fallback) | Met | presets only; `midModel` derived from the preset's own values | | NFR-4 (async only) | Met | fs/promises; lazy imports | | NFR-5 (file-size caps) | Met | lint green on CI | ## Verification - CI on exact HEAD ec3dc03b (run 36593911789, event pull_request, conclusion success): build, lint-group core/effect/skills/state, test-shard 1-4, test-e2e, and the clean install smoke test all pass. `overdeck/test` reports "Verification gate passed". - `npm run lint` chains `lint:effect-diagnostics` (package.json line 110), so the effect-diagnostics check is covered by that green exact-HEAD run. - The new backend tests run in the normal `vitest run`. The frontend test is in `test:frontend-subset`. - Runtime probe 1 (scratchpad, isolated HOME/OVERDECK_HOME, no creds, no codex on PATH): real `getProviderAuthMode` + `planPresetApply` confirmed the blocker. - Runtime probe 2 (scratchpad, isolated home, tiered config with a distribution and a supervisor, stubbed auth): apply then undo for `anthropic` and `openai` succeeded, `isDeepStrictEqual` was `true`, and the bytes differed only in flow-sequence padding and re-emitted distribution style. - Not run: the full test suite (per role), and Playwright/UAT (no isolated dashboard; the host dashboard would write the operator's real config). Source: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-4400/.pan/review/agent-pan-4400-review-ec3dc03b/review.md ## Required action Fix every blocking review finding, commit the fixes, then re-request review with: `pan review request PAN-4400 -m "Fixed review issues"`
